meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: Claude 会变成 Git 专家:收到 git 请求时,先分析仓库的提交风格与分支状态,再把改动拆成多个小而独立的提交,并负责合并提交(rebase/squash)、查找某行代码是谁写的、何时加入的。
howto.when: 当您发出任何 git 操作请求时触发,例如说 “commit”、要求 rebase/squash,或问某行代码是谁写的。

say.text: 把这 8 个改动按目录拆成几个小提交,再逐个提交。
say.note: Claude 会先分析文件再拆分提交。

say.text: 把最近 5 个提交 squash 成一个,并写好提交信息。
say.note: Claude 会合并历史并重写信息。

say.text: 查一下 42 行这段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的。
say.note: Claude 会用 git blame 查历史。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a Git expert: on git requests it analyzes repo commit style and branch state, splits changes into multiple small independent commits, and handles rebase/squash and history search (who/when a line was added).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user makes any git operation request, e.g. says 'commit', asks for rebase/squash, or asks who wrote a line.

say_en.text: Split these 8 changes into small commits by directory, then commit them.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes files then splits commits.

say_en.text: Squash the last 5 commits into one with a clean message.
say_en.note: Claude merges history and rewrites the message.

say_en.text: Find who wrote line 42 and when.
say_en.note: Claude uses git blame to trace history.
